extract_notes: skip: PFAS-only study (74 legacy+novel PFAS in background soils) — no target OP (PAH/PCB/DDT/HCH/PBDE/PHC/antibiotics/PAEs/OCPs) or HM (Cd/Pb/Cr/As/Hg/Cu/Zn/Ni) data. This is a nationwide PFAS survey (Environ Sci Technol 2024) with 124 surface soil samples across 31 Chinese provinces. All measured pollutants are PFAS congeners not in the extraction target list. Original data at SI-Original Data.xlsx.
